title: DatasetSampleRecord
description: Validated metadata record representing an individual sample within an ML dataset split.

sample_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the sample record.

sample_hash.description: Canonical 64-character lowercase SHA-256 digest of the sample binary.

dataset_name.description: Name of the originating dataset collection (e.g. 'ember').

dataset_version.description: Version identifier of the originating dataset (e.g. '2018', '2019').

source_record_id.description: Optional upstream or external dataset sample identifier.

target_label.description: Normalized binary classification target class: 0 for benign, 1 for malicious.

source_label.description: Original raw label from the source dataset prior to normalization.

label_provenance.description: Attribution or method used to assign the label (e.g. 'avclass_family', 'vendor_consensus').

split.description: Partition split assignment for model training and evaluation.

feature_schema_version.description: Identifier of the feature extraction schema applicable to this sample.

relative_path.description: Optional relative path to sample binary within dataset archive (rejects absolute, UNC, drive-prefixed, or traversal paths).

collected_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the sample was observed or collected.
